fixes_applied.1_isolation_cleanup: Unique RUN_ID; accounts tagged loadtest-journey-v2:<RUN_ID>:<pool>:<i>; a manifest of the exact created user_ids is tracked; DELETE removes ONLY those ids (no prefix wipe, no known-clean pre-delete); trap cleans up on failure too; cleanup verifies remaining==0 and fails visibly (nonzero) otherwise; tokens stored in a 0700 out-of-repo mktemp dir (file 0600), never printed or committed.
fixes_applied.2_match_validation: matches.profile_revision must equal the reloaded profile revision (stale detection); fixture check requires a known-relevant (adjudicated label>=2) job for the profile to appear in results; response-validation failures kept separate from HTTP/transport failures.
fixes_applied.3_idempotent_saves: One Idempotency-Key per payload; transient retries reuse the SAME key; valid replay (200 changed=false) accepted; success declared only after reload confirms result_revision and canonical content round-trip; REVIEW_REQUIRED handled as a new-key confirmation of the returned cleaned draft; keys never rotated to hide failures; deterministic validation errors never retried.
fixes_applied.4_deadlines: Per-step monotonic deadline (30 s); per-request timeout and backoff bounded by remaining budget; Retry-After honoured, and if it exceeds remaining budget the step STOPS (no early retry, no sleeping past the deadline); attempt-budget vs elapsed-deadline exhaustion recorded separately.
fixes_applied.5_integrity: Run FAILS with nonzero exit on any digest difference; scope excludes only THIS run's users so all pre-existing AND other-run synthetic rows are protected; deterministic, NULL-safe md5 over documented tables/fields (see integrity.sql header); does NOT claim 'all database content' unchanged, only the covered fields; emits only md5+counts (no tokens/PII/resume text).
fixes_applied.6_interpretation: Removed the six unsupported claims; observations, hypotheses and unmeasured behaviour are distinguished; busy rejections and exhausted journeys are labelled unsuccessful outcomes.

verification.cleanup_on_failure_observed: A first run aborted mid-way (a psql -c variable bug in the optional evidence query); the EXIT trap still deleted exactly this run's accounts and all integrity digests matched the before-snapshot — cleanup-on-failure verified in practice.
